attempted_claim: At prime p=2 and chromatic height h=2, does the Morava-stabilizer homotopy fixed point spectral sequence E_2^{s,t}=H^s_c(G_2; pi_t E_2) => pi_{t-s} L_{K(2)}S^0 admit a strong horizontal vanishing line at filtration h^2+N = 4+N, where N = max_{finite G subset G_2} N_{2,G} -- i.e. filtration 29 for N_{2,Q_8}=2^5-7=25, respectively filtration 27 for the refined N_{2,Q_8}=2^5-9=23 -- via the anticipated length-h^2=4 finite resolution of L_{K(2)}S^0 by the finite fixed points E_2^{hG}?
decisive_failure: The finite-subgroup vanishing inputs and the 29/27 arithmetic were verified against published theorems and local computation, but the resolution leg of the target could not be completed: no length-4 finite resolution of the full K(2)-local sphere at (p,h)=(2,2) was found, the literature explicitly flags doubling as impossible, and the general bound stands as an open conjecture, so neither proof nor disproof was achievable in this pass.
